title: Main branch updates - Claude 4.5/4.6, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek Reasoner
description: Added support for Claude 4.5/4.6 models, expanded Gemini model support with 2.5 Flash/Lite and 3 preview, added DeepSeek Reasoner model, and improved exception handling. Aider wrote 62% of the code in this release.

title: Codex CLI 0.149.1 with agent dashboard and improvements
description: New release adds interactive agents dashboard, working directory commands, queue for sessions, and expanded Vim editing. Includes bug fixes for queued messages, resumed sessions, and WebRTC connections.

title: Codex MCP server command deprecated
description: The `codex mcp-server` command is now deprecated. Users should use the Codex app server instead, or the Codex plugin for Claude Code.

title: New Copilot experience in Slack and Microsoft Teams
description: GitHub Copilot now brings shared agentic work to Slack and Microsoft Teams, allowing teams to collaborate with AI directly in their communication platforms.

title: Origin Code Hosting, Cloud Agents Improvements, and iPad Support
description: Cursor can now host your code with Origin repos and pull requests. Cloud agents start 3x faster with Builds, improved Google Workspace plugins integration, and Cursor for iPad is now available on all paid plans with inbox and review features.

community_feedback.quote: Origin - Cursor's code hosting platform is now live!

title: Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash available in Copilot
description: New AI models Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash are now available in GitHub Copilot, providing developers with more model choices for AI-assisted coding.

community_feedback.quote: It's a great model, It is definitely smarter, but it seems to use more tokens and turns complete slower. This makes it somewhat awkward to use.
Gemini-3.7-flash is surprisingly pleasant to use. I prefer it. It's fast and much better at UI.
my favorite model is still grok-4.6. Best...
